notes.title: Tech Update
notes.notes:
Just some updates to keep the game running :-)

There was also a bug with the game crashing, which was fixed as well.

This game is basically what it is and due to low interest will not receive any further content updates anymore - so if you just enjoy some basic tower defense and maze macking, it may be for you but don't expect a high polished game with lots of content - it's just simple TD
